errors.description: Part (b) Step 3: the key claim that the set of common divisors of the two valuations is preserved by (α,β)↦(min,|α−β|) is asserted without proof, and the passage from 'common divisors of the pair preserved' to 'gcd of the whole 2026-tuple preserved' is only asserted ('In all cases G_p is invariant'). Both are one-liners but are the heart of Part (b).
